referents.why: 'their secret arts' is third masculine plural; the owners of the arts are the magicians (w4).
'they were not able' is third common plural; the subject of the attempt, the magicians (w4).

links.why: This refers to a clause of the previous verse (Exo.8.13 cl4), and across verses the link is the episode rung, not then.
lamed plus infinitive construct: the act was done to bring forth the gnats.
An attempt with a purpose, then and plus a negated verb of being able, is the attempt's failed_result, not a plain and.
The magicians tried to bring forth gnats and it did not happen: 'and they were not able'.
wayyiqtol continues the narrative line: the gnats then remained on man and beast.
A named subject does 'did so' (ken) for a deed not commanded to them: bringing forth gnats by a like act, after the latest command (strike the dust). Imitation, not fulfilment.
links.category: imitation of a deed just done
